facts.text: The Model T flies home for dinner.
facts.why: Brainard's flying car in this film is a vintage Ford Thunderbird. The Model T belongs to the 1961 original, The Absent-Minded Professor.
facts.fix: The Thunderbird flies home for dinner.

facts.why: Same slip in the winks list. The flying car is a Ford Thunderbird.

facts.text: Serve dessert when the flubber starts dancing around the lab.
facts.why: Wikipedia has Weebo letting Flubber dance around the house after the basketball game. The lab is part of Brainard's house, so the cue is close, but the sources say house.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when the flubber starts dancing around the house.

vibe.verdict: The green lab suits the film, but it swaps in the wrong car and leaves out Smith and Wesson, the flubber shoes and Weebette.
